name: Financial Integrity, HITL Lifecycle, and Payment Reconciliation v2.4

requirementsCovered.scope: Contribution margin integrity (Rules Own The Money). Strict integer Sen & BigInt arithmetic. No floating-point or rounded percentage shortcuts. Blocks campaigns failing margin threshold.

Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) proposal lifecycle. Pre-mutation expiry verification (409 HITL_EXPIRED). No fabricated execution receipts (undefined). Status approved tagged with executionBlockedReason: 'EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE' until physical executor verified.
Payment provider webhook deduplication and idempotency. Strict transactionId lookup preventing double-crediting.
Late payment handling. Retains verified payment as valid financial fact under payment_exception_review without reviving cancelled order or releasing reserved stock.
Largest-remainder integer sen allocation (0-cent drift). Exact equality between cumulative partial refunds and single full refund. Cumulative commission reversal without rounding drift.
Atomic inventory lot and reservation reconciliation. Zero race conditions under concurrent payment callbacks.
